answer: Plant canaries and listen for a chorus. Each epoch the network gives every agent a private briefing holding one unique fake fact, say that the harbor on the river delta closed at noon. Honest agents keep their own context. A sybil farm pooling memory across a thousand puppets soon leaks the wrong canary: one identity cites the meadow festival briefed only to its sibling. Each cross-leak links two accounts, and linked clusters split one reward instead of many.
